title: RefundSucceeded v1
description: Payment tells that the provider gave the money of one payment back in full. Routing key: payment.refund-succeeded. Sent once per payment, even when the provider reports the refund more than once (ADR-0006, rule R4); a refund that the provider has not confirmed is never reported. It carries identifiers, the amount, the currency and the reason Booking gave: no card data, no personal data. Consumers ignore unknown fields (ADR-0009, part F).

eventId.description: ID of this message, used by consumers to recognize duplicates

correlationId.description: The correlation ID of the request that caused the message, or null when no request did (a timer, a consumer)

aggregateId.description: The payment; the same as data.paymentId

bookingId.description: The booking the payment was for

amountMinor.description: The amount given back, in the smallest unit of the currency (all of the payment)

reason.description: The reason in the refund request
